summary: First full run. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed (clientes/ordens/agendamentos/midias/config CRUD, cascades, 404/422, stats, relatorio, backup). Frontend: Flyer (mobile 390x844) opens, canvas 405x720 scaled to 366x651 with no horizontal overflow; all fields are pre-filled and editable; tipo checkboxes toggle on and off; download gives a 1215x2160 PNG (9:16, scale 3) that includes the edited values; send falls back to download plus a WhatsApp popup; close works. Desktop regression: Dashboard, Clientes CRUD, Ordens CRUD/conclude/delete, Agenda create/edit/conclude/delete, Garantias/Midias/WhatsApp/Config load, Config save all PASS with no page errors. Found: emojis get corrupted in the WhatsApp text because of the wa.me redirect, Config can't be reached on mobile, and the html2canvas PNG has some cosmetic misalignments. Note: there is no /api/garantias endpoint; Garantias are worked out from ordens on the client, which is fine.

minor.issue: ag_hoje uses the UTC date. Brazil is UTC-3, so after 21:00 local time 'Visitas Hoje' counts tomorrow's appointments.
Accepts an empty nome "" (only a missing nome gives 422). No min_length validation.

ui_bugs.component: lib/api.js waLink (used by FlyerModal, Ordens comprovante, WhatsApp, Clientes)
ui_bugs.issue: wa.me redirects to api.whatsapp.com/send/ and turns 4-byte emojis (🔥👤📞📍📅⏰🔧💰📝📱) into U+FFFD '�'. Verified: curl -I 'https://wa.me/55..?text=%F0%9F%94%A5' returns Location text=%EF%BF%BD. Every flyer reminder text arrives with broken symbols. Fix: build links as https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=${full}&text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}.

On mobile (PWA) the Config page can't be reached: MOBILE_NAV has no config, the header has no menu, and the Dashboard links only to Midias and Garantias. The user can't edit telefone/cidade/slogan, run backups or see reports on a phone.
decodeURIComponent(msg) throws URIError if any OS field has a '%' (e.g. '50% desconto'), so the Comprovante button silently fails. Build the message with \n and drop the %0A/decode round-trip.
new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) is the UTC date. After 21:00 in Brazil the default date for new OS/agendamento and the 'today' highlight in Agenda move to tomorrow. Use the local date.

issues: Lucide icons in the header badges (SEGURANÇA/QUALIDADE/CONFIANÇA), the Soluções row and the phone icon sit higher than their text (baseline misalignment in the exported image only).
Tipo checkboxes in the PNG sit above their labels, and the ✓ inside the selected box is tiny and pushed to the bottom edge, barely visible.
The 'OBSERVAÇÕES' label overlaps the top border of the obs box in the PNG, and the box mixes a solid border with a dashed bottom.
Vertical spacing is uneven (justify-content: space-between): big gaps between Endereço, Cidade and Data, while the Serviço/Detalhe/Observações rows are crammed. Use fixed gaps instead.
The on-screen flyer looks fine; the problems show up only in the exported image. Consider explicit line-heights/heights on the flex rows, or html-to-image instead of html2canvas.
The cancel (X), edit (pencil) and delete (trash) buttons have no data-testid or aria-label (icon-only). The date/time/valor/obs inputs in agenda-modal also have no data-testid.

action_items: Switch waLink to https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=...&text=... so emojis aren't corrupted
Make Config reachable on mobile (add it to the bottom nav or a header gear button)
Remove decodeURIComponent in Ordens comprovante (crashes when a field has '%')
Use the local date in hoje() (frontend) and in /api/stats ag_hoje (backend: America/Sao_Paulo)
Fix flyer PNG alignment: icons, checkbox ✓, Observações label overlap, uneven vertical spacing
Add data-testid/aria-label to the Agenda cancel/edit/delete icon buttons and the modal date/time/valor/obs inputs
critical_code_review_comments: FlyerModal: useState(initForm) runs only on mount. That works because Agenda unmounts the modal on close, but if cfg loads after mount (getConfig is async) the cidade stays empty. Low risk.
Agenda/Ordens setStatus/concluir/remove have no try/catch, so failed API calls give no error toast
Backend: no input validation on status/tipo enums (any string accepted); POST /restore deletes collections with no schema validation
Server clock reports 2026-10-27, while the request context says Jan 2026, so seed data dates are October 2026

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all flows work; emoji corruption in WA text and mobile Config access are the main gaps)

seed_data_creation: A temporary TEST_ client, agendamentos, ordens and midias were created and all removed. Config was restored to its original values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. Navigation is state-based: desktop uses nav-{id}-button, mobile uses mnav-{id}-button (dashboard, clientes, os, agenda, whatsapp only). Flyer: agenda-view-lista, then agenda-flyer-{id}, then flyer-modal. Download PNG is 1215x2160. Run the backend tests with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported: pytest /app/backend/tests/. Check that the wa link no longer goes through wa.me (look at the popup URL for %EF%BF%BD).
rca of the issue: Emoji corruption: the WhatsApp wa.me short-link server re-encodes the text param during its 302 redirect to api.whatsapp.com/send/ and replaces supplementary-plane chars (emojis) with U+FFFD. The app's encodeURIComponent is correct. Reproduce with curl -sI 'https://wa.me/5532988881111?text=%F0%9F%94%A5test' and check the Location header. Mitigation: link to api.whatsapp.com/send directly.
